headers._comment: Default everything to no-cache. Header `source` globs match the REQUEST path, not the rewritten one, so a rule listing /index.html literally never matches the paths users actually load: /, /onboarding, /roles/:id all rewrite to index.html but keep their own request path. Codex verified this against `firebase emulators:start --only hosting` on PR #434 — /index.html got the header, / and /roles/abc did not, so a reload from the update banner could still be served a cached entry document and keep running the superseded bundle. Matching ** and then re-allowing the hashed assets below is the ordering fiveacross already uses in production.

Vite emits content-hashed filenames under /assets, so these are immutable by construction: a new build produces new names rather than new contents at the same name. Listed after the ** rule because a later matching entry wins.
